summary.text: Jackie Baginski, listed by Ballotpedia as Jacquelyn Baginski, is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 17 since January 5, 2021, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate.

paragraphs.text: Jacquelyn Baginski lives in Cranston, Rhode Island, graduated from Moses Brown School and earned a degree from George Washington University in 2008.
Her career experience includes working as director of sales and marketing for Professional Ambulance and as director of Dardan Consulting.
In the 2021-2022 session she was assigned to the House Finance and State Government and Elections committees.
